import sys,time,random,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate
# extract build_cs definitions from test file
src=open('/workspace/tmp/test_cost_scaling_quota.py').read().split('def make_job')[0]
ns={};exec(src,ns)
R=int(sys.argv[1]);O=int(sys.argv[2]);P=int(sys.argv[3])
NQ=4096;NOQ=4096
def forest(n):
 nodes=[]
 for i in range(n):
  nodes.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if i%32==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':4096})
 return nodes
rq=forest(NQ);oq=forest(NOQ)
leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}]
services=[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}]
random.seed(7)
reqs=[]
for i in range(R):reqs.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':f'2001:db8:{(i>>16)&0xffff:x}:{i&0xffff:x}::1','service':'s','group':f'n{(i*7)%NQ}'})
offers=[]
for j in range(O):
 listed=[f'r{(j*37+k*127)%R}' for k in range(P)]
 offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,101),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':1 if 'cap1' in sys.argv[0] else random.randrange(0,5),'cost':random.randrange(0,10**9),'group':f'n{(j*11)%NOQ}','requests':listed})
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}
t=time.time();ctx=validate(job);print('validated',time.time()-t)
active={f'r{i}':True for i in range(R)}
t=time.time();res,rounds=ns['build_cs'](ctx,active);dt=time.time()-t
print('solved',dt,'resolved',res['resolved'],'cost',res['cost'],'rounds',rounds,'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
EOF
cd /workspace && timeout 400 python3 tmp/bench_cs_quota.py 4096 8192 32
